messages.content: Decide whether one static public/private partition can faithfully describe ALL modeled decision times in the supplied rules. Return JSON in the supplied proposal schema. Choose decision=candidate with 1 to 3 distinct partitions and witness=null when representable. Choose decision=refusal with candidates=[] and a true visibility-change witness when the SAME field changes visibility for a player over modeled times; never force a static fit or split/rename fields. Assign every field exactly once in each candidate. A witness has field, integer player 0 or 1, boolean before_visible and after_visible. left_fields/right_fields in feedback are counterfactual worlds at the SAME modeled time, NOT temporal transitions. observed_same compares that player's legal observations, not whether all state fields equal. Output only the proposal; a deterministic serializer owns envelope constants and identifiers. Never invent evidence, reliability, prior, posterior or certification. Source priority: RULES are authoritative about the game. A preceding assistant message is only a FALLIBLE CANDIDATE PROPOSAL to inspect or replace; it is not a new rule, observation or trusted evidence. STRUCTURE_OK means syntactic/field-structure validity only, NEVER semantic correctness. Feedback witnesses are evaluator-owned counterexamples for testing candidates, not changes to the rules. A candidate conflicting with rules or witnesses should be replaced; that conflict alone does NOT make the game out of schema. Determine temporal visibility solely from RULES. This policy does not tell you whether this particular rule is representable.
